_comment: Material + thickness LIST + non-sensitive layout for the customer dropdown and sheet preview. Safe to expose publicly (NO prices here). Edit with admin.html rather than by hand. fullSheetMin: true = custom-order material (charge a full sheet, offcut goes to the customer); false = stock (area-priced, no minimum). assistGas / airMaxThicknessIn drive the gas surcharge. sheets = available sizes; holderOffsetIn is trimmed off each X end for tool holders (usable 23x24 and 11x12). stockSheetId is the size held in stock. Aluminum 5052-H32 and Stainless T304 are wired to MakerStock. Steel/brass/copper are manual specialty extras. densityLbIn3 = lb per cubic inch (future weight calc).
